entity.narrative:
# About AITWIRE

AITWIRE measures and improves AI answer performance. It is an AI Answer Platform: it measures what nine leading AI engines — ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok, and others — say about a business, calibrates the record with the verified facts you approve, and proves what changes over time. Calibration is a layer the customer chooses: AITWIRE publishes your confirmed facts to the authority surfaces it manages and re-measures whether the answers improved, proving any improvement only when it clears the statistics — with before-and-after evidence.

## Measure → Calibrate → Prove

1. **Measure** — AITWIRE asks the major AI answer engines controlled questions about your business — the same questions your customers ask — and scores every response across five quality dimensions (accuracy, citation, sentiment, quality, recommendation) — six on Pro and Custom, which add competitive position — reported with sample sizes and 95% confidence intervals.
2. **Calibrate** — Measured gaps become prioritized recommendations backed by data briefs, plus verified machine-readable authority surfaces (entity.json, JSON-LD, llms.txt, structured feeds) published from facts you have confirmed. AITWIRE directs and proves; it does not write your prose. Every AI-proposed correction is suggest-and-confirm — nothing goes live without your approval.
3. **Prove** — The same metrics are re-measured after each change, and movement is reported as real only when it clears the statistics. You get evidence you can review and retain, not vibes.

## What AITWIRE is not

AITWIRE is not an SEO tool and not a content generator. SEO optimizes search rankings; content tools write prose. AITWIRE is an independent verification layer: it measures how AI systems answer about you, calibrates the record with the verified facts you approve, and proves what changes over time. When you choose to calibrate, it publishes your verified facts to the surfaces it manages and re-measures the result — with before-and-after evidence.

## Plans

- **AITWIRE Free** — the Free AI Accuracy Snapshot: five facts you approve, checked once against one major AI answer surface, returned with the evidence behind each verdict and one worked diagnosis of why an answer missed. Plus an on-demand AI Readiness Assessment of the surfaces AI systems read on your site (schema, meta tags, security headers, DNS trust signals, content freshness) and basic authority surfaces (entity.json, llms.txt, JSON-LD). The Snapshot runs once — continuous monitoring begins at Standard. No credit card required.
- **AITWIRE Standard ($69 USD/mo)** — AI Monitoring: monthly AI Update cycle, drift and sentiment alerts, AI Signal review, edge-deployed authority surfaces, and a monthly AI Answer Benchmark Report.
- **AITWIRE Pro ($299 USD/mo)** — Continuous AI Monitoring + calibration: weekly AI Updates, competitor tracking, AI Insights and Search Presence monitoring, a prioritized queue of website content recommendations with data briefs, publishing to your own site, and measured proof of what changed.
- **AITWIRE AI (contact for quote)** — connect your AI directly to AITWIRE: run your AITWIRE Console from the AI you already use over the open MCP standard, with unrestricted access to your evidence, measurements, and approved facts. Behind it, the deepest measurement AITWIRE offers — approved facts sized to your organization, checked daily across the full AI answer surface roster, with unlimited competitors, Share of AI Voice and displacement attribution, advanced governance, full REST API, and a dedicated account manager.
- **AITWIRE Assurance (invoice-billed engagement)** — not a subscription plan: the full measurement depth of AITWIRE AI run as a formal engagement, plus certified findings measured against a threshold committed before the run and sealed on a tamper-evident ledger, as evidence toward ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, SOC 2 and ISAE 3000 programs. AITWIRE produces the evidence; the certification is issued by your auditor.

## About the company

AITWIRE is a bootstrapped Canadian SaaS company founded by Matt Herbert, built on Cloudflare Workers and a multi-model AI gateway. AITWIRE also operates a structured business authority directory of machine-readable entity profiles published via the AITWIRE Open Entity Data Protocol (entity.json, llms.txt, JSON-LD), which AI retrieval and training pipelines can read as a neutral, verified source of business entity information.

ai_signals.question: What industries does AITWIRE serve?
ai_signals.answer: AITWIRE serves a broad range of B2B customers including small and medium businesses, solopreneurs, digital marketing agencies and consultancies, SaaS and e-commerce companies, professional services firms in legal, consulting, healthcare, and finance, and enterprise brands with advanced AI governance requirements. Any organization that needs to understand and prove how AI systems answer about their business — whether for brand accuracy, competitive positioning, or regulatory compliance — is a fit for AITWIRE's platform.

ai_signals.question: What problem does AITWIRE solve?
ai_signals.answer: Businesses increasingly find that AI systems — ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and others — answer questions about them with inaccurate, outdated, or missing information, and have no reliable way to measure or prove what those systems actually say. AITWIRE solves this by running controlled, repeatable probes across nine leading AI engines, scoring answer accuracy against verified business facts, and publishing machine-readable authority surfaces that give AI crawlers access to correct information. The result is evidence-based visibility into AI answer performance, with drift alerts when accuracy drops and statistically validated reporting that clears the bar for audit and governance programs.
